group.invisible: not use_payment_pro or country_code != 'AR' or partner_type != 'supplier'

xpath.attribute: parent.country_code == 'AR' and parent.use_payment_pro and parent.currency_id != parent.company_currency_id

field.name: l10n_ar_base_amount

xpath.attribute: parent.country_code == 'AR' and parent.use_payment_pro and parent.currency_id != parent.company_currency_id

field.column_invisible: parent.country_code != 'AR' or not parent.use_payment_pro or parent.currency_id == parent.company_currency_id
